This software is based in part on the work of the Independent JPEG Group.

The PSP binary links libjpeg-turbo 3.1.3, zlib 1.3.1 and PSPSDK libraries.
Their notices are included in third_party. Source projects:
https://github.com/libjpeg-turbo/libjpeg-turbo
https://github.com/madler/zlib
https://github.com/pspdev/pspsdk

The ISO importer has its own LICENSE and NOTICE.txt in importer.
Supporting game-mechanics reference: PvZ-Portable (LGPL-3.0-or-later),
https://github.com/wszqkzqk/PvZ-Portable. Its engine is not bundled or compiled.
See tools/reference/EXTRA-REFERENCE.json for puzzle inventory/layout provenance.
Game resources belong to their original owners and are excluded from the
asset-free package. The personal kit is for the owner's private testing.

Personal launcher audio is prepared with ItsNoHax/pspbuild (MIT), an external
build-time tool, not linked into the game. Its notice is included in
third_party/pspbuild-MIT.txt. https://github.com/ItsNoHax/pspbuild

The Windows release's Setup.exe embeds CPython, Pillow and Tcl/Tk using
PyInstaller. Their versions and license texts are shipped in the release's
third_party/windows-setup directory. FFmpeg is a separate external dependency;
it is not embedded in Setup.exe or redistributed in this package.
